summary: 掌握九大类状语从句的细微差别与易混连词辨析：when/while/as、unless/provided、now that/in case 等。

rules.title: 时间：when / while / as 辨析
rules.detail: when 既可接短暂动作也可接延续动作；while 只接延续动作且常表对比；as 强调「随着、一边……一边」。

examples.en: As time goes by, things will get better.
examples.zh: 随着时间的推移，情况会好转。

examples.en: He was reading while his wife was cooking.
examples.zh: 他在读书，而妻子在做饭。

rules.title: 条件：unless / as long as / in case / on condition that
rules.detail: unless = if not；as long as 表示「只要」；in case 表示「以防万一」；条件从句仍遵守「主将从现」。

examples.en: As long as you keep trying, you will succeed.
examples.zh: 只要你坚持尝试，就会成功。

examples.en: Take an umbrella in case it rains.

rules.title: 让步：although / even if / no matter + 疑问词
rules.detail: although 不与 but 连用；even if 表「即使」（假设）；no matter how + 形容词/副词 = however + 形容词/副词。

examples.en: No matter how hard the work is, we must finish it on time.
examples.zh: 不管工作多难，我们必须按时完成。

examples.en: Even if it rains, the match will not be cancelled.
examples.zh: 即使下雨，比赛也不会取消。

rules.title: 方式 / 地点：as / as if / where
rules.detail: as 表「按照……方式」；as if / as though 表「好像」（可接虚拟语气）；where 引导地点状语从句。

examples.en: Do it as I told you.
He talks as if he knew everything.
examples.zh: 他说得好像什么都知道似的。

pitfalls: although 与 but 连用（中式思维陷阱）
no matter what 与 whatever：引导状语从句两者可换，引导名词性从句只能用 whatever
in case 后用一般现在时：in case it rains（不是 will rain）

questions.stem: ___ you have made up your mind, don't change it easily.
questions.explain: once 表示「一旦」，引导条件状语从句，符合句意「一旦下定决心」。

questions.stem: No matter ___ hard the task is, we should finish it.
questions.explain: no matter how + 形容词/副词：无论任务多么难。

questions.stem: He spoke in a low voice ___ he were talking to himself.
questions.explain: as if/as though 表示「仿佛」，从句可用虚拟语气（were）。

questions.stem: ___ the weather is bad, the sports meeting will be put off.
questions.explain: in case 表示「以防」，主句用将来时 will be put off。

questions.stem: ___ ___ you are a student, you should follow the school rules. (two words: 既然)
questions.explain: now that 表示显而易见的原因「既然」。

questions.stem: ___ ___ hard the problem is, never give up. (two words: 无论多么)
questions.explain: no matter how + 形容词/副词；注：标准答案为 no matter how，仅填 no matter 不完整。

questions.stem: Although he works very hard, but he can't support his family.
questions.answer: 去掉 but（或把 although 改为 /）
questions.explain: 英语中 although 与 but 不能同时使用。

questions.stem: 无论你去哪里，我都会跟着你。（翻译整句）
answer: no matter where you go, i will follow you.
wherever you go, i will follow you.
questions.explain: no matter where = wherever，引导让步状语从句。

questions.stem: 只要你认真学习，就不会落后。（翻译整句，fall behind）
answer: as long as you study hard, you won't fall behind.
so long as you study hard, you will not fall behind.
questions.explain: as long as 表示「只要」，从句用一般现在时，主句将来时。
